subject.title: refactor(state): split openclaw-agent-db into focused modules under the line limit

question: After real agent-database open and migration/maintenance proof is attached, should the persistence-area owner accept this behavior-neutral module-boundary refactor?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label and movement of persistence lifecycle code require an explicit human acceptance decision even if focused tests remain green.

options.title: Review after runtime proof
options.body: Require a redacted fresh-open and existing-database migration/maintenance transcript, then review the persisted-state boundary changes.

options.title: Defer the refactor
options.body: Keep the current module layout until a persistence-area owner has capacity to review the extraction and its upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Review after runtime proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted fresh-open and existing-database migration/maintenance transcript, then review the persisted-state boundary changes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on the adjacent state-database split makes this the strongest available routing signal for the extracted persistence boundaries.
